payload.summary: Unconfirmed claim: 808 D-band sources lack publisher, version and jurisdiction metadata; the cited debt acceptance expired 2026-08-31
payload.detail: The 2026-10-09 audit cites docs/release-source-metadata-debt-2026-06-30.json for 808 sources, but that number is not in the file. The file records an acceptance with expires_at 2026-08-31 and observed 0 sources missing the required metadata keys in early July. Unknown whether the expiry is enforced or the 808 comes from a different count. Next action: take a fresh count (npm run backfill:source-metadata is provider-backed and needs explicit approval first), then either record a new bounded acceptance or close.
payload.source: Review of five Antigravity reports against main, 2026-10-12
